headers.it: Dung kroekhaih cabu maeto haih hoi hnetto haih loe Samuel cabu hoi Siangpahrang cabu thungah thuih tangcae thuih let ih lok ah oh. Toe David siangpahrang ah ohhaih kawng to lokpui koekah amtueng. Hae cabu thungah loe acaeng anghumhaih kawng doeh oh; David ukhaih hoi anih mah toenghaih hoiah prae to uk naah lokpui ah kaom muithla kawng to doeh a thuih. Dung kroekhaih cabu 1 - 2 to thungah loe misong ohhaih prae thung hoi kamlaem Judah kaminawk tha angthawkhaih kawng to thuih moe, Sinai mae ah paek ih lokkamhaih to pazui hanah thuih ih thapaekhaih lok to oh. Hae cabu tarik koehhaih takung pui hnetto oh. Maeto haih loe, Israel hoi Judah prae loe amro boeh, toe Sithaw loe a lokkamhaih to phrae ai, a lokkamhaih akoepsak hanah Judah prae thungah kaom kami to patoh vop tih. Hnetto haih loe, Jerusalem ah Sithaw bok amtonghaih kawng to thuih; bokim ah toksah kaminawk, qaimanawk hoi Levinawk hanah pazet ih tok kawng doeh a thuih. Bokhaih im sak hanah amtong kami loe David ni, toe Solomon mah ni sak tangtang. Hae cabu mah kricaanawk doeh toenghaih loklam ah caeh ai nahaeloe, natuek naah doeh khosak hoihhaih hnu thai mak ai, tiah amtuengsak.

verses.text: \s1 Zaehoikungnawk dung kroekhaih
Adam, Seth, Enosh,

2-4 Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enok, Methuselah, Lamek, Noah. Noah, Shem, Ham hoi Japheth.   
\s1 Japheth acaengnawk
Japheth ih caanawk loe, Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek hoi Tira.
Gomer ih caanawk loe, Ashkenaz, Riphath hoi Togarmah.

Javan ih caanawk loe, Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim hoi Rodanim.   
\s1 Ham acaengnawk
Ham ih caanawk loe, Kush, Mizraim, Put hoi Kanaan.
Kush ih caanawk loe, Seba, Havilah, Sabta. Raamah ih caanawk loe, Sheba hoi Dedan.
Kush ih capa loe Nimrod, anih loe long nuiah misatuk thacak kami ah oh.
Mizraim mah Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim hoi Naphtuhim,
Pathrusim, Kasluhim (hae kami khae hoiah Philistin hoi Paphtorim acaengnawk anghum o).
KanaAn mah capa kacoeh koek Sidon hoi Hetht to sak;
anih loe Jebus, Amor, Girgash,

Arvad, Zemar hoi Hamath acaengnawk ih ampa ah oh.   
\s1 Shem ih acaengnawk
Shem ih capanawk loe, Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud hoi Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether hoi Meshek ah oh.
Arphaxad loe Shelah ih ampa ah oh moe, Shelah mah Eber to sak.
Eber mah capa hnetto sak; capa maeto tapen naah long tapraekhaih ah oh pongah, Peleg, tiah ahmin sak moe, amnawk loe Joktan, tiah ahmin sak.
Joktan mah Amodad, Sheleph, Hazar-Maveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah hoi Jobab to sak; hae kaminawk boih loe Joktan ih caa ah oh o.
Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,

Abram (Abraham) cae hae ni.   
\s1 Abraham caanawk
Abraham capa hnik loe, Issak hoi Ishmael.
Hae kaminawk loe nihnik ih caa ah oh o; Ishmael ih calu loe Nabaioth; to pacoengah Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

Jetur, Naphish hoi Kedemah; hae kaminawk loe Ishmael ih caa ah oh o.   
\s1 Keturah ih caanawk
Abraham ih zula Keturah mah sak ih caanawk loe, Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak hoi Shuah. Jokshan ih caanawk loe, Sheba hoi Dedan.

Midian ih caanawk loe Ephah, Epher, Henok, Abida hoi Eldaah; hae kaminawk loe Keturah ih caa ah oh o boih.   
\s1 Sarah ih caanawk

Abraham loe Isaak ih ampa ah oh; Isaak ih caa hnik loe, Esau hoi Israel.   
\s1 Esau ih caanawk
Esau ih caanawk loe, Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam hoi Korah.
Eliphaz ih caanawk loe Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam hoi Kenaz, Timna hoi Amalek.

Reul ih caanawk loe Nahath, Zerah, Shammah hoi Mizzah cae hae ni.   
\s1 Edom ah kaom Seir kaminawk
Seir ih caanawk loe Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezar hoi Dishan.
Lotan ih caa hnik loe, Hori hoi Homam; Timna loe Lotan ih tanuh ah oh.
Shobal caanawk loe Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi hoi Onam; Zibeon capa hnik loe, Aiah hoi Anah.
Anah capa loe Dishon; Dishon ih caanawk loe, Amram, Eshban, Ithran hoi Keran.

Ezer ih caanawk loe Bilhan, Zavan hoi Jakan; Dishan caa hnik loe, Uz hoi Aran.   
\s1 Edom siangpahrangnawk
Israel kaminawk siangpahrang tawn o ai naah, hae kaminawk loe Edom prae ah siangpahrang ah oh o; Beor capa Bela, anih ih vangpui ahmin loe Dinhabah.
Bela duek pacoengah, Bozrah ah kaom Zerah capa Jobab to siangpahrang ah oh.
Jobab duek pacoengah, Teman prae ih Husham to siangpahrang ah suek o.
Huhsam duek pacoengah, Bedad capa Hadad, Moab prae ih Midian kaminawk pazawkkung to, anih zuengah siangpahrang ah oh; anih vangpui ih ahmin loe Avith.
Hadad duek pacoengah, Masrekah prae ih Samlah to siangpahrang ah oh.
Samlah duek pacoengah, vapui taeng Rehoboth ah kaom, Shaul to siangpahrang ah oh.
Shaul duek pacoengah, Akbor capa Baal-Hanan to siangpahrang ah oh.
Baal-Hanan duek pacoengah, anih zuengah Hadad to siangpahrang ah oh; anih ih vangpui hmin loe Pai; anih zu ih ahmin loe Me-Zahab canu Matred, Matred canu Mehetabel.
Hadad doeh duek. Edom ih kacoehtanawk loe, Timna, Aliah, Jetheth,
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
Magdiel hoi Iram; hae kaminawk loe Edom prae kacoetanawk ah oh o.
\s1 Israel ih caanawk
Israel caanawk loe, Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Ishkar, Zebulun,

Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad hoi Asher.   
\s1 Judah ih caanawk
Judah ih caanawk loe, Er, Onan hoi Shelah; hae thumtonawk loe Kanaan nongpata Shua canu ih caa ah oh o. Judah calu Er loe Angraeng mikhnukah kami kasae ah oh; to pongah anih to Angraeng mah paduek.
Judah ih langah Tamar mah Perez khae hoiah Zerah to sak. Judah loe capa pangato tawnh.
Perez ih caa hnik loe, Hezron hoi Hamul.
Zerah ih caanawk loe Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol hoi Dara, sangqum boih ah pangato oh o.
\x - \xo 2:7 \xt Josh 7.1.\x*Karmi capa loe Akhar; anih loe tangoeng ah kaom Angraeng han pahoe ih hmuen to lak pongah, Israel nuiah raihaih phasakkung ah oh.
Ethan capa loe, Azariah.

Hezron mah sak ih caanawk loe, Jerahmeel, Ram hoi Khelubai cae to ni.   
\s1 Hezron capa Ram
Ram loe Amminadab ih ampa ah oh; Amminadab loe Judah kaminawk zaehoikung Nashon ih ampa ah oh.
Nashon mah Salmon to sak, Salmon mah Boaz to sak,
Boaz mah Obed to sak moe, Obed mah Jesse to sak.
Jesse ih calu loe Eliab, hnetto haih capa loe Abinadab, thumto haih loe Shimma,
palito haih loe Nethanel, pangato haih loe Raddai,
tarukto haih loe Ozem, sarihto haih loe David;
nihcae ih tanunawk loe Zeruiah hoi Abigail. Zeruiah ih caanawk loe Abishai, Joab hoi Asahel.

Abigail mah Amasa to sak, ampa loe Ishmael acaeng Jether.   
\s1 Hezron capa Kaleb
Hezron capa Kaleb mah a zu Azubah hoi Jerioth hnik khae hoiah sak ih caanawk loe, Jesher, Shobab hoi Ardon.
Azubah duek pacoengah, Kaleb mah Ephrath to zu haih moe, anih hoiah Hur to sak.
Hur mah Uri to sak, Uri mah Bezalel to sak.
To pacoengah Hezron mah Gilead ampa Makir canuh to iih haih, saning quitarukto oh naah, to nongpata to ani mah zu haih, anih mah Segub to sak pae.
Segub mah Jair to sak; anih loe Gilead prae ah vangpui quitarukto tawnh.
Geshur hoi Aram hnik mah Jair vangpui to lak; Kenath hoi a taengah kaom vangpui quitarukto doeh a lak hoi; hae kaminawk loe Gilead ampa Maakir ih caa ah oh o boih.

Hezron duek pacoengah, Kaleb mah ampa ih zu Ephratah to iih haih; Hezron ih zu Abijah mah anih hanah Tekoa ih ampa Ashhur to sak pae.   
\s1 Hezron capa Jerahmeel
Hezron ih calu Jerahmeel ih caanawk loe, calu Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem hoi Ahijah.
Jerahmeel loe zula maeto tawnh; anih ih ahmin loe Atarah; anih loe Onam ih amno ah oh.
Jerahmeel calu Ram ih caanawk loe, Maaz, Jamin hoi Eker.
Onam ih caa hnik loe, Shammai hoi Jada; Shammai ih caa hnik loe, Nadab hoi Abishur.
Abishur ih zu loe Abihail, anih mah Ahban hoi Molid to sak.
Nadab capa hnik loe, Seled hoi Appaim; Seled loe caa sah ai ah duek.
Appaim capanawk loe, Ishi, anih mah Sheshan to sak moe, Sheshan mah Ahlai to sak.
Shammai ih amnawk Jada capa hnik loe, Jether hoi Jonathan; Jether loe caa sah ai ah duek.
Jonathan ih caa hnik loe, Peleth hoi Zaza; hae kaminawk loe Jerahmeel ih caa ah oh o.
Sheshan loe capa tawn ai, canunawk khue ni tawnh; anih loe Jarha, tiah kawk ih Izip kami tamna maeto a tawnh.
Sheshan loe a tamna Jarha hanah canu to paek moe, anih mah Attai to sak pae.
Zabad mah Ephial to sak moe, Ephial mah Obed to sak,
Obed mah Jehu to sak moe, Jehu mah Azariah to sak,
Azariah mah Helez to sak moe, Helez mah Eleasah to sak,
Eleasah mah Sisamai to sak moe, Sisamai mah Shallum to sak,

Shallum mah Jekamiah to sak moe, Jekamiah mah Elishama to sak.   
\s1 Kaleb ih acaeng
Jerahmeel amnawk Kaleb ih capanawk loe Mesha, anih loe calu ah oh; anih loe Ziph ih ampa ah oh, anih ih capa loe Mereshah, anih loe Hebron ih ampa ah oh.
Hebron ih capanawk loe Korah, Tappuah, Rekem hoi Shema.
Shema mah Raham to sak moe, Raham mah Jorkeam to sak; Rekem mah Shammai to sak.
Shammai ih capa loe Maon; Maon mah Beth Zur to sak.
Kaleb ih zula Ephah mah, Haran, Moza hoi Gazez to sak; Haran mah Gazez to sak.
Jahdai capanawk loe Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah hoi Shaaph.
Kaleb ih zula Maakah mah Sheber hoi Tirhanah to sak.
Anih mah Mad-mannah ih ampa Shaaph, Macbenah hoi Gibea ampa Sheva to sak; Kaleb ih canu loe Aksah.
Ephratah ih calu Hur ih capa, Kaleb ih caanawk loe, Kiriath-Jearim ampa Shobal,
Bethlehem ih ampa Salma hoi Berth-Gader ih ampa Harep.
Kiriath-Jearim ih ampa Shobal ih caanawk loe, Haroh, ahap Manahath ih kaminawk,
Kiriath-Jearim acaengnawk loe, Ithra kaminawk, Put kaminawk, Shumat kaminawk hoi Mishra kaminawk ah oh o; hae kaminawk khae thung hoiah ni Zareat kaminawk hoi Eshtalat kaminawk to tacawt.
Salma ih caanawk loe, Bethlehem, Netophat, Atarot, Joab imthung takohnawk, ahap Manahethi kami hoi Zori kaminawk ah oh o.
Jabez ah kaom ca tarik acaengnawk, Tirathi kaminawk, Shimeathi kaminawk hoi Sukathi kaminawk to oh o. Hae kaminawk loe Rekab imthung takoh ih ampa Hammath khae hoi angzo Ken kami ah oh o.
\s1 David ih caanawk
Hebron ah oh naah David mah sak ih capanawk loe, Jezreel kami Ahinoam mah calu Ammon to sak pae; Karmel tanuh Abigail mah capa hnetto haih Daniel to sak pae;
Geshur siangpahrang Talmai canu Maakah capa Absalom loe, thumto haih ah oh moe, Haggith capa Adonijah loe palito haih ah oh.
Pangato haih loe, Abital capa Shephatiah; tarukto haih loe a zu Eglah hoiah sak ih Ithream.

\x - \xo 3:4 \xt 2 Samuel 5.4,5; 1 Siang 2.11; 1 Dung 29.27.\x*Hae ih capa taruktonawk loe Hebron ah saning sarih, khrah tarukto uk naah, David mah sak ih capa ah oh o; David mah Jerusalem vangpui to saning quithumto pacoeng, saning thumto thung uk.
\x - \xo 3:5 \xt 2 Samuel 11.3.\x*Jerusalem ah sak ih caanawk loe, Shimea, Shobab, Nathan hoi Solomon; hae capa palitonawk loe Ammiel canu Bathshua mah sak pae;
nihcae pacoengah, Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
Elishama, Eliada hoi Eliphelet cae to sak; sangqum boih ah takawtto oh o.

Hae kaminawk boih loe David ih capa ah oh o; a zulanawk ih caanawk thui ai ah, nihcae ih tanuh Tamar doeh oh.   
\s1 Solomon imthung takohnawk
Solomon ih capa loe Rehoboam, Rehoboam ih capa loe Abijah, Abijah ih capa loe Asa, Asa ih capa loe Jehosaphat,
Jehosaphat ih capa loe Joram, Joram ih capa loe Ahaziah, Ahaziah ih capa loe Joash,
Joash ih capa loe Amaziah, Amaziah ih capa loe Azariah, Azariah ih cap aloe Jotham,
Jotham ih capa loe Ahaz, Ahaz ih capa loe Hezekiah, Hezekiah ih capa loe Manasseh,
Manasseh ih capa loe Amon, Amon ih capa loe Josiah.
Josiah ih capanawk loe calu Johanan; hnetto haih loe Jehoiakim, thumto haih loe Zedekiah, palito haih loe Shallum.
Jehoiakim ih caanawk loe a capa Jekoniah, Jekoniah ih capa loe Zedekiah.
Misong ah naeh ih Jekoniah ih capanawk loe Assir, Assir capa Shealtiel,
Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama hoi Nedabiah.
Pedaiah ih capanawk loe, Zerubabel hoi Shimei; Zerubabel ih capa hnik loe, Meshullam hoi Hananiah; Shelomith loe nihnik ih tanuh ah oh.
Kalah pangatonawk loe Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah hoi Jushap-Hesed.
Hananiah ih caanawk loe Pelatiah hoi Jeshaiah; Rephaiah ih capa loe Arnan, Arnan ih capa loe Obadiah, Obadiah ih capa Shekaniah cae to athum o.
Shekaniah ih caanawk loe Shemaiah; Shemaiah ih capanawk loe Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah hoi Shaphat; sangqum boih ah tarukto oh o.
Neariah ih capanawk loe Elionai, Hezekiah hoi Azrikam, sangqum boih ah thumto oh o.
Elionai capanawk loe Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah hoi Anani; sangqum boih ah sarihto oh o.
\s1 Kalah Judah acaengnawk
Judah ih caanawk loe Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur hoi Shobal.
Shobal ih capa Reaiah mah Jahath to sak, Jahath mah Ahumai hoi Lahad to sak. Ha kaminawk loe Zorath ih acaeng ah oh o.
Hae kaminawk loe Etam ih caa ah oh o; Jezreel, Ishma hoi Idbash; nihcae tanuh ih ahmin loe Hazelelponi.
Penuel mah Gedor to sak, Ezer mah Hushah to sak. Hae kaminawk loe Ephratah ih calu, Bethlehem ampa, Hur ih caa ah oh o.
Tekoa ampa Ashur loe zu hnetto lak, Helah hoi Narah.
Naarah mah Ahuzzam hoi Hepher, Temeni hoi Haahastari to sak pae. Hae kaminawk loe Naarah ih caa ah oh o.
Helah ih caanawk loe Zereth, Jezoar, Ethnan.
Koz loe Anub, Zobebah hoi Harum capa Aharhel ih imthung takoh kaminawk to sak.
Jabez loe angmah ih nawkamyanawk pongah pakoeh han krah kami ah oh; anih to palungsethaih hoiah ka tapen pongah, amno mah Jabez, tiah ahmin sak.

Jabez loe Israel Sithaw khaeah, Aw nang mah tahamhoihaih nang paek moe, ka prae hae nang kaawksak! Palungset khuiqahhaih hoi sethaih thung hoiah ka loih o thai hanah, na ban hoiah pakaa ah, tiah a hang. A hnik ih lok baktih toengah Sithaw mah paek.
Shuah ih amnawk Kelub mah Mehir to sak; anih loe Ashton ih ampa ah oh.
Eshton mah Beth-Rapha, Paseah, Ir-Nahash ih ampa Tehinah to sak. Hae kaminawk loe Rekah ih kami ah oh o.
Kenaz capa hnik loe, Othniel hoi Seraiah; Othniel ih capa hnik loe, Hathath.
Meonothai mah Ophrah to sak moe, Seraiah mah Joab to sak, Joab ih caanawk loe bantok sah kop kami ah oh o pongah, Kharashim azawn ah khosak o.
Jephunneh capa Kaleb ih caanawk loe, Iru, Elah hoi Naam; Elah capa loe, Kenaz.
Jehallelel ih capanawk loe Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria hoi Asarel.
Ezra ih caanawk loe Jether, Mered, Epher hoi Jalon; Mered zu maeto mah Miriam, Shammai hoi Eshtemoa ih ampa Ishbah to sak.
A zu Jehudijah mah Gedor ampa Jered, Soko ampa Heber hoi Zanoah ampa Jekuthiel to sak pae. Hae kaminawk loe Mered mah zu ah lak ih Faro canu Bithiah ih caa ah oh o.
Naham tanuh Hodiah zu ih caanawk loe Garmi acaeng Keilah ampa hoi Maakah acaeng Eshtemoa.
Shimon caanawk loe Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan hoi Tilon. Ishi ih caanawk loe Zo-Heth hoi Ben-Zoheth.
Judah capa Shelah ih caanawk loe Lekah ampa Er, Mareshah ampa Laadah hoi puu tlangqui pathokhaih bangah toksah Ashbea imthung takohnawk,
Jokim, Kozeba ih kaminawk, Moab hoi Jashubi-Lehem ukkung, Joash hoi Saraph cae to ni. Hae ah tarik ih ca loe canghnii hoiah ni oh boeh.

Hae kaminawk loe laom sah kaminawk, lawksah kaminawk ah oh o pongah siangpahrang ih toksak hanah anih taengah oh o.   
\s1 Simeon ih acaengnawk
Simeon ih caanawk loe Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah hoi Shaul.
Mishma capa, Hammuel, Hamuel capa Zakur, Zakur capa Shimei.
Shimei loe capa hatlaitarukto hoi canu tarukto tawnh; toe anih ih amnawk loe caa kapop ah tawn ai, to pongah nihcae acaeng loe Judah acaengnawk zetto om o ai.
\x - \xo 4:28 \xt Josh 19.2-8.\x*Nihcae loe Beer-Sheba, Moladah hoi Hazar-Shual,
Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad;
Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
Beth-Markaboth, Hazar-Susim, Beth-Birei hoi Sharaim ah oh o. Hae kaminawk loe David siangpahrang ah oh nathung, angmacae ih vangpui ah oh o.
Nihcae ih vangtanawk loe Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token hoi Ashan, taih vangpui pangato oh.
Hae vangpuinawk taengah kaom vangtanawk boih loe Baal karoek to athum. Hae kaminawk loe angmacae ohhaih ahmuen ah oh o; angmacae anghumh tathukhaih ah oh.
Meshobab, Jamlek, Amaziah capa Josiah,
Joel, Jehu loe Joshibiah capa, Joshibiah loe Seraiah capa, Seraiah loe Asiel capa,
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
Ziza loe Shiphi capa, Shiphi loe Allon capa, Allon loe Jedaiah capa, Jedaiah loe Shimri capa, Shimri loe Shemaiah capa ah oh;
ahmin hoi thuih ih hae kaminawk loe angmacae acaeng zaehoikung ah oh o; nihcae ih acaeng loe paroeai pung o.
To kaminawk loe tuu pacahhaih ahmuen to pakrong o moe, ni angyae bang ih azawn, Gedor ramri khoek to caeh o.
Nihcae mah phroh kapop, long kahoih ahmuen, kawk parai ahmuen, monghaih hoi kamding rue ah kaom prae to hnuk o; Ham kaminawk loe to ahmuen ah canghnii hoiah ni oh o boeh.

Ahmin tarik ih kaminawk loe Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah dung naah angzoh o; to ahmuen loe tuu pacah han hoih parai pongah, to ah kaom Ham kaminawk to boh o moe, imnawk to a phraek pae o pacoengah, vaihni ni khoek to to ah khosak o.
Simeon kami cumvai pangatonawk loe, Ishi ih caa misatuh angraeng Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah hoi Uzziel cae hoi Seir mae ah caeh o moe,
canghniah kaloih Amalek kaminawk to hum o, to ahmuen ah vaihni ni khoek to khosak o.

\x - \xo 5:1 \xt Genesis 35.22; 49.3,4.\x*Israel calu Reuben ih caanawk, anih loe calu ah oh, toe ampa ih iihkhun to amhnongsak pongah, calu ah ohhaih ahmuen to Israel capa Joeseph ih caanawk hanah paek ving boeh; to pongah acaeng paruihaih loe calu ah ohhaih baktiah tarik o ai.
\x - \xo 5:2 \xt Genesis 49.8-10.\x*Calu ah ohhaih loe Joseph ih qawk ah oh boeh, toe anih ih nawkamya thung hoiah ukkung, thacak koek Judah to tacawt,
Israel calu Reuben ih caanawk loe Hanok, Pallu, Hezron hoi Karmi.
\x - \xo 5:4 \xt 2 Siang 15.29.\x*Joel ih caanawk loe Shemaiah capa Gog, Gog capa Shimei,
Shimei capa Mikah, Mikah capa Reaiah, Reaiah capa Baal, Baal capa,
Beerah, anih loe Assyria siangpahrang Tilgath-Pileser mah misong ah naeh; Beerah loe Reuben kaminawk zaehoikung ah oh.
Nihcae ih nawkamya Jeiel hoi Zekariah loe acaeng anghumhaih ahmin paruihaih cabu thungah pakuem o;
Joel capa Shema, Shema capa Azaz, Azaz capa Bela loe Aroer vangpui, Nebo vangpui hoi Baal-meon vangpui khoek to oh o;
Gilead prae ah nihcae mah pacah ih maitawnawk loe paroeai pung pongah, ni angyae bang ih Euphrate vapui hoi praezaek ramri karoek to akun o moe, khosak o.

Saul siangpahrang dung ah Hagar ih kaminawk to tuk o moe, nihcae pazawk pongah Hagar kaminawk ohhaih prae Gilead ni angyae bang boih ah khosak o.   
\s1 Gad acaengnawk
Gad kaminawk loe nihcae taengah khosak o; Bashan prae thung Salekah vangpui khoek to oh o;
Joel loe kalen koek ah oh, Shapham loe hnetto haih ah oh, to pacoengah Jaanai hoi Shaphat loe Bashan ah oh hoi.
Nihcae ih acaengnawk loe Mikael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia hoi Eber; sangqum boih ah sarihto oh o.

\s1 Ammon kaminawk hoi misa angtukhaih
To nathuem ah Ammon siangpahrang Nahash loe duek moe, a capa mah anih zuengah uk.

David mah, Anih ih ampa mah kai ang tahmen pongah, Nahash capa Hanun nuiah tahmenhaih kam tuengsak han, tiah a poek. Ampa kawng pongah palungsethaih amtuengsak hanah David mah Hanun khaeah laicaeh patoeh. David ih kaminawk loe, Hanun khaeah palungsethaih lokthuih hanah Ammon prae ah angzoh o.

Toe Ammon angraengnawk mah Hanun khaeah, David mah nam pa nuiah palungsethaih amtuengsak han ih ni, pathloep kaminawk to patoeh, tiah na poek maw? Anih ih tamnanawk loe prae to khet moe, paro han hoi misatuk han ih na ai maw angzoh o? tiah a naa o.
Hanun mah David ih kaminawk to naeh moe, sam to aah pae; khukbuen to laetabu khoek to aah pae pat moe, amlaemsak let.

To pacoengah kangcoeng hmuen kawng to kami maeto mah David khaeah thuih pae. Nihcae to paroeai azat thokah sak o pongah, nihcae tongh hanah anih mah kami to patoeh. Siangpahrang mah, Na toektaboe mui tacawt ai karoek to, Jeriko vangpui ah na oh o pacoengah, amlaem oh, tiah thuih, tiah a naa.

David hanah hmuisae hmuen a sak pae o boeh, tiah Ammon kaminawk mah panoek o naah, Hanun hoi Ammon kaminawk mah Mesopotamia prae, Syria-Maakah hoi Zobah prae hoiah hrangleeng, hrang angthueng kaminawk to tlai hanah, phoisa talent sangto a pat pae.

Nihcae mah hrangleeng sing thum, sang hnetto, Maakah siangpahrang hoi anih ih misatuh kaminawk to tlai pongah, nihcae loe angzoh o moe, Medeba taengah atai o. Ammon kaminawk loe avang maeto pacoeng maeto ah amkhueng o moe, misatuk hanah caeh o.
David mah to tamthang to thaih naah, Joab hoi thacak angmah ih misatuh kaminawk to patoeh boih.
Ammon kaminawk loe angzoh o moe, angmacae ih vangpui sipae khongkha ah misatuk hanah amkhueng o; angmacae koeh ah angzo siangpahrangnawk loe taw thungah oh o.

Kalah misatuh kaminawk loe amnawk Abishai hanah uksak, nihcae loe Ammon kaminawk tuk hanah amsak o.
Joab mah, Syria kaminawk thacak o hmoek nahaeloe, kai hae na bom ah, nang hanah Ammon kaminawk thacak o hmoek nahaeloe, kai mah kang bomh han, tiah a naa.
Misahoih ohsak loe, aimacae kaminawk hoi aimacae ih Sithaw hanah, misahoihaih hoiah tuh si; Angraeng mah a mikhnukah kahoih hmuen to sah nasoe, tiah a naa.
Joab hoi a taengah kaom kaminawk loe Syria misatuk hanah caeh o boih; Syria kaminawk loe nihcae hmaa ah cawnh o.
Syria kaminawk cawnh o boeh, tiah Ammon kaminawk mah hnuk o naah, nihcae doeh amnawk Abishai hmaa ah cawnh o toeng moe, vangpui thungah akun o. To pacoengah Joab loe Jerusalem ah amlaem let.

Israel kaminawk hmaa ah misa sung boeh, tiah Syria kaminawk mah panoek o naah, nihcae mah laicaehnawk to patoeh o moe, vapui yaeh ah kaom Syria misatuh kaminawk to kawksak; Hadarezer ih misatuh angraeng Shophak mah nihcae to caeh haih.

To lok to David khaeah thuih pae o naah, anih mah Israel kaminawk boih to pakhueng moe, Jordan vapui to angkat o; nihcae khaeah phak o moe, nihcae tuk hanah amsak o. David loe Syria kaminawk tuk hanah amsak moe, nihcae hoi misa angtuk o.

Toe Syria kaminawk loe Israel kaminawk hmaa ah cawnh o; David mah hrangleeng nuiah angthueng kami sang sarihto hum moe, khok hoi misatuh kami sing palito a hum; nihcae ih misatuh angraeng Shophak doeh a hum pae.

Israel kaminawk mah pazawk boeh, tiah Hadarezer taengah kaom tamnanawk mah panoek o naah, David hoi angdaehhaih sak o moe, anih ih tamna ah oh o. To pongah Syria kaminawk mah Ammon kaminawk abomh han koeh o ai boeh.

Ornan loe cang atit li moe, hnukbang angqoi naah, van kami to hnuk; a taengah kaom a capa palitonawk loe anghawk o king.
David loe Ornan khaeah caeh, Ornan mah anih to hnuk naah, cang atithaih to toengh sut moe, David hmaa ah long ah akuep.

Ornan mah David khaeah, La ah, ka angraeng siangpahrang mah a koeh ih hmuen to sah nasoe; khenah, hmai angbawnhaih paek hanah maitawnawk doeh kang paek; cang atit naah patoh ih thing doeh kang paek, angdaeh angbawnhaih sak hanah cang doeh kang paek; hmuennawk hae kang paek boih, tiah a naa.

Toe David siangpahrang mah Ornan khaeah, To tih na ai, kakoep ah atho kang paek han; nang ih ahmuen to Angraeng hanah azom ah ka la mak ai, atho hoi qan ai ih hmuen hoiah angbawnhaih ka sah mak ai, tiah a naa.
To pongah David mah Ornan ih lawkhmuen qanhaih atho sui shekel cumvai tarukto paek.

David mah to ahmuen ah Angraeng hanah hmaicam to sak; hmai angbawnhaih hoi angdaeh angbawnhaih to a sak moe, Angraeng to kawk; Angraeng mah kawkhaih lok to van hoiah pathim pae, angbawnhaih hmaicam to hmai mah kangh pae.

Israel prae thungah kaom angvinnawk nawnto amkhueng hanah David mah lokpaek; anih mah Sithaw im sak hanah thlung sah kop kaminawk to tok paek.

paroeai kapop sidar thing doeh a paek; Sidon hoi Tura vangpui ih kaminawk mah David hanah paroeai pop sidar thing to sin pae o.

David mah, Angraeng ih ban ka nuiah oh pongah, hae hmuen sak han kamtueng krang, panoek thaihaih to ang paek, tiah thuih.

David mah a capa Solomon khaeah, Thacaksak ah loe, misahoihaih hoiah tok to sah ah; zii hmah loe, palung doeh boengsak hmah; na Angraeng Sithaw, ka Sithaw loe nang khaeah oh; Angraeng ih im sak hanah tok pacoeng ai karoek to anih mah na caeh taak mak ai ueloe, toksak pacoeng ai ah omsak mak ai, tiah a naa.

Khenah, qaimanawk hoi Levi acaengnawk loe Sithaw im toksak hanah, nang hoi nawnto om o tih; bantok sah kop kaminawk boih mah doeh, hmuen boih sakhaih bangah na bomh o tih; angraengnawk hoi rangpuinawk boih doeh na thuih ih lok baktih toengah om o tih, tiah a naa.
\s1 Tempul sak han hmuen paekhaih

\x - \xo 29:1 \xt 1 Dung 22.5.\x*To pacoengah David siangpahrang mah kamkhueng kaminawk boih khaeah, Sithaw mah qoih ih, ka capa Solomon loe nawkta moe, saning doeh nawk vop; sak han koi tok loe len parai; siangpahrang im loe kami han ih na ai, Angraeng Sithaw han ih ni.

Ka Sithaw ih im hanah sui hoi sak han koi hmuen to sui, sumkanglung hoi sak han koi hmuen to sumkanglung, sumkamling hoi sak han koi hmuen to sumkamling, sum hoi sak han koi hmuen to sum, thing hoi sak han koi hmuen to thing, thlung hoi sak han koi hmuen to Onyx thlung, rong kampha thlung, rong congca kampha thlung, atho kaom congca thlung hoi thlung kanglungnawk doeh, ka sak thai thung paroeai sak hanah ka paroep boeh.
Ka Sithaw bokhaih im ah palung ka suek pongah, ciimcai im sakhaih hmuennawk loe ka tawnh ih hmuennawk, im sak han ka paroep ih sui hoi sumkanglung to ka Sithaw ih im ah ka paek boih boeh,
tasa bang hoiah im tapang pazut hanah, ophir sui talent sang thumto, atui kaciim sumkanglung talent sang sarihto,
sui hoi sak han koi hmuennawk to sui, sumkanglung hoi sak han koi sumkanglung to, ban toksah kop kaminawk khaeah ka paek boih boeh. Mi maw vaihniah Angraeng khae angpaek han ka koeh? tiah a naa.
To pacoengah imthung takoh lu koek, Israel acaeng angraengnawk, misatuh kami sangto ukkung, cumvaito ukkung angraengnawk hoi siangpahrang toksah ukkungnawk loe anghoehaih hoiah angpaek o.
Nihcae loe Sithaw im toksak haih hanah, sui talent sang pangato, sui darik sang hato, sumkanglung talent sang hato, sumkamling talent sang hatlaitazetto hoi sum talent sang cumvaito a paek o.
Atho kana thlung tawn kaminawk doeh, Gershom acaeng Jehiel ban ah, Angraeng im ih hmuen pakuemhaih ahmuen ah a paek o.

Kaminawk loe paek koehhaih hoiah paek o pongah anghoe o; Angraeng khaeah paawt ai ah palung tang hoiah a paek o; David siangpahrang doeh paroeai anghoehaih hoiah oh.   
\s1 David lawkthuihaih
David mah rangpui hmaa ah, Kaicae ampa Israel ih Angraeng Sithaw, nang khaeah dungzan khoek to, tahamhoihaih om nasoe, tiah Angraeng to tahamhoihaih paek.

\x - \xo 29:11 \xt Mathai 6.13.\x*Aw Angraeng, nang loe lenhaih, thacakhaih, pakoehhaih, pazawkhaih hoi ranui koekah lensawkhaih ah oh; long hoi van ah kaom hmuennawk boih loe nang ih ni; Aw Angraeng, nang mah na uk moe, kaminawk boih nuiah na oh.
Angraenghaih hoi pakoehhaih loe nang khae hoiah ni angzoh; nang loe hmuennawk boih ukkung ah na oh; kaminawk boih na lensak, thacakhaih paek hanah, na ban ah sakthaihaih hoi thacakhaih to oh.
To pongah vaihi, kaicae ih Sithaw, nang to tahamhoihaih kang paek o moe, na hmin lensawkhaih kang pakoeh o.

Paek koehhaih palung hoiah hae tih khoek to ka paek o thai hanah, kai hoi kai ih kaminawk loe kawbaktih kami ah maw ka oh o? Hmuen boih loe nang khae hoiah ni angzoh, na ban hoi ka hnuk o ih hmuen ni nang khaeah kang paek o.
Kaicae loe kam panawk baktiah na hmaa ah angvin ah ni ka oh o; long ah kaicae hinghaih loe tahlip baktiah ni oh, oep han koi om ai.
Aw kaicae ih Angraeng Sithaw, ciimcai na hmin hanah, na im sak ka paroep o haih hae hmuennawk boih loe na ban hoiah ni angzoh, hmuennawk boih loe nang ih ni.

Ka Sithaw, nang loe palung to na khingh moe, toenghaih to nang hoe haih, tiah ka panoek. Kai loe hae hmuennawk boih hae poek toenghaih hoi paek koehhaih palungthin hoiah ni kang paek; vaihi hae ah kaom nangmah ih kaminawk mah paek koehhaih palungthin hoiah nang khaeah paek o ih hmuen hae anghoehaih hoiah ka hnuk boeh.

Aw kaicae ampa Abraham, Issak hoi Israel ih Angraeng Sithaw, hae tiah hmuenmae paek koehhaih palungthin hae nangmah ih kaminawk palung thungah omsak poe ah loe, nihcae ih palungthin doeh nang khaeah omsak ah;

na paek ih loknawk, na thuih ih loknawk hoi na lok takroekhaih dannawk to palungthin boih hoiah pazui moe, sak ka tim ih siangpahrang im to a sak pacoeng thai hanah, ka capa Solomon khaeah kakoep palungthin to paek ah, tiah lawkthuih.

To pacoengah David mah rangpuinawk khaeah, Na Angraeng Sithaw to tahamhoihaih paek oh, tiah a naa. To pongah kaminawk boih mah ampanawk ih Sithaw to bok o moe, Angraeng hoi siangpahrang hmaa ah akuep o.   
\s1 Solomon siangpahrang ah ohhaih

Khawnbangah Angraeng khaeah hmuen tathlanghaih to sak o, Angraeng khaeah hmai angbawnhaih to a sak o; maitaw tae sangto, tuu tae sangto, tuucaa sangto, naek koi hmuennawk, angbawnhaih hmuen paekhaihnawk to Israel caanawk boih hanah paek o.

To na niah Angraeng hmaa ah anghoehaih hoiah a caak o moe, naek o. To pacoengah a capa Solomon to vai hnetto haih ah, siangpahrang ah suek o let; Angraeng hmaa ah, ukkung ah situi to bawh o moe, tok paek o pacoengah Zadok to qaima ah cak o sak.

\x - \xo 29:23 \xt 1 Siang 2.12.\x*To pongah Solomon loe, ampa David zuengah, angraeng tangkhang pongah siangpahrang ah anghnut; a qoengh tahang moe, Israel kaminawk boih mah anih ih lok to tahngaih pae o.
Angraengnawk boih hoi thacak kaminawk, David siangpahrang capanawk boih mah doeh, Solomon siangpahrang khaeah ang paek o.

Israel kaminawk boih mikhnukah Angraeng mah Solomon to tapom tahang, Israel siangpahrangnawk mah tawn o vai ai ih lensawk siangpahrang to paek.   
\s1 David duekhaih
Jesse capa David loe Israel kaminawk boih nuiah siangpahrang ah oh.
\x - \xo 29:27 \xt 2 Samuel 5.4,5; 1 Dung 3.4.\x*Israel kaminawk to saning quipalito uk; Hebron ah saning sarihto uk moe, Jerusalem ah saning quithum, thumto uk.
Anih loe saning kasawkah hing; angraenghaih hoi pakoehhaih hoiah oh moe, mitong naah duek; anih zuengah a capa Solomon to siangpahrang ah oh.
Khenah, David siangpahrang ah oh naah, toksakhaihnawk loe amtonghaih hoi boeng khoek to, tahmaa Samuel, tahmaa Nathan hoi tahmaa Gad ih cabu thung ah oh,
anih ukhaih hoi a lensawkhaih, angmah hoi Israel kaminawk hoiah kalah praenawk nuiah kaom hmuennawk kawng to tarik o.
